possibleExceptionCodes.description: An alias list of exception code names as keys and their .Net enum names as values. Tests can list an exception code alias as their expectation.

possibleExternalMethodSources.description: An alias list of external method names as keys and their fully qualified assembly names as values. Tests may be register these for use in their 'transformer' property.

testGroups.description: An array of test groups, each group containing a specific area that they cover (e.g. math operators)

name.description: The name of the test group. It should be descriptive of the functionality that it targets (e.g.  math operators)

source.description: The JSON object that acts as the incoming source document that will be transformed in all of the tests in this group.

externalMethodSource.description: The alias name of an external method that may be used within a transformer in all of the tests in this group.

tests.description: An array of tests that are contained in this group.

name.description: The name of the test. It should be descriptive of the functionlity that it targets (e.g. The >= operator should return true when the number on the left is larger)

transformer.description: The JSON object that acts as the transformer for this test group's incoming source document.

result.description: The JSON object that acts as the expected result of this test.

exceptionCode.description: The alias name of an exception code that this test expects to receive as a result of this test.

innerExceptionCode.description: The alias name of an exception code on the expected exception's inner exception that this test expects to receive as a result of this test.
